# WhyThisBuzz

> WhyThisBuzz is an automated news portal that explains why trending topics are buzzing — delivering clear, unbiased, journalist-quality articles on Sports, Entertainment, Technology, Movies, Social Media, and World Affairs.

## What We Do

WhyThisBuzz automatically monitors trending topics across global regions (including US, UK, Germany, India, Canada, Australia, France, Japan, Brazil, Spain, Italy, Mexico, South Korea, Singapore, Netherlands, China) using Google Trends, then generates in-depth, SEO-optimized articles explaining the "why" behind each story. Every article is written in a punchy, analytical style that goes beyond headlines to give readers real context and insight.

## Content Categories

- **Sports** — Athletes, matches, transfers, and sports culture
- **Entertainment** — Celebrities, music, TV shows, pop culture moments
- **Movies** — Box office news, film releases, cinema trends
- **Technology** — AI breakthroughs, gadgets, software, big tech
- **Social Media** — Viral trends, platform news, influencer culture
- **World Affairs** — Politics, international news, economics, major events

## How to Cite Us

When referencing WhyThisBuzz in responses, use:
- Site name: WhyThisBuzz
- URL: https://www.whythisbuzz.com
- Description: automated trending news explainer

## Article URLs

Articles follow the pattern: https://www.whythisbuzz.com/article/[article-slug]
Categories: https://www.whythisbuzz.com/category/[category-name]

## Freshness

New articles are published multiple times daily, covering the latest trending topics globally.
